description: This file defines a class AOS_PDF_TemplatesDashlet for the SuiteCRM module AOS_PDF_Templates. It extends DashletGeneric and manages the dashlet's initialization, including setting titles, search fields, columns, and seed bean. It also includes license information and security checks.

classes.name: AOS_PDF_TemplatesDashlet
classes.description: A dashlet class for displaying and managing AOS PDF Template records within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the dashlet, initializes properties like title, search fields, columns, and seed bean, based on configuration and language translation.
